first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and shortening onboarding has previously improved time-to-value and adoption. Verify the archived onboarding and activation records to assess whether the effects were durable and whether onboarding simplification plausibly addresses both issues. Avoid promotional pricing because its acquisition lift came with materially worse 30-day retention, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard activation-messaging experiment because activation is down 6% and the verified record showed activation +6%, week-one engagement +11%, and 30-day retention +1%. Do not shorten onboarding for complex-workspace accounts: although completion improved, 60-day churn increased 9% there. Retain segmented onboarding changes as a separate future option for simple accounts rather than spend this week's slot on a broader rollout.
